Then book a deluxe room at Marriott New York for Alex Johnson from 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-12. Also check alice’s availability starting 2026-01-10 using calendar user ID u_alice. After that, scan the devices in the bedroom, choose the smart lock, and unlock the main lock lock_main with PIN 2026 so the lock state is unlock. Finally, send alice a high-priority app alert that says: “Travel booking is complete and the destination room lock has been prepared.”
